meta.setup_step_description: Collate cross-device screen resolution metrics for target mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.
meta.expected_output: Approved JSON Token File and an interactive structural layout wireframe for compact mobile devices.
meta.reviewer_note: SSTLA-004's metric is a Task Execution Quality Score (1-5) scored by a reviewer against a rubric. The objective coverage half is computed by the gate; the reviewer score must be entered by a human before this step can exceed its Floor of 3.5.

decision_record.rationale: Material 3 compact window-size class. 4 columns is the MD3 compact standard and the narrowest device we support (320dp) still yields a 60dp column, which clears the 48dp touch-target floor set by TTMAC-011.

conflict_resolved.issue: RCGLA-012 says 'explicitly at 16px with an 8px gutter grid system'. RCGLA-032 substep 1 says '16px outer margin and a 16px column gutter spacing profile'.
conflict_resolved.resolution: Two distinct tokens. column_gutter_dp = 16 (horizontal space between grid columns, per RCGLA-032 which names it explicitly and is echoed by its UI decision row). vertical_rhythm_dp = 8 (the baseline step, which is what RCGLA-012's own UX Translation row calls a 'continuous 8px vertical rhythm alignment'). Both are gated.
conflict_resolved.cross_check: RCGLA-032's own metric row lists Floor 4dp / Optimal 8dp / Ceiling 16dp, which the 8dp vertical rhythm hits at Optimal.

devices.name: Desktop web (baseline)
devices.mobile_configuration: expanded / 12-column / content capped at 840dp reading width

coverage_rubric._metric: Task Execution Quality Score (1-5 scale) -- SSTLA-004
objective_criteria: every window class has at least one device in the matrix
the narrowest supported width (320dp) is represented
both iOS and Android are represented
phone, tablet and desktop device types are all represented
every RCGLA-032 test width (360, 375, 412) is represented
coverage_rubric.scoring: Each objective criterion is worth 1.0 of the 5.0 total, computed by SSTLA-004-G6. A reviewer may reduce the score but the gate holds the objective floor.
